rules.instruction: When the description states that one participant presents alternatives to another participant, whose selection determines which subsequent work is performed.: Model obtaining the selection as an interaction activity (a user task when a person must respond), followed by an exclusive gateway that routes the alternatives; do not model the interaction as separate send and receive tasks.
rules.situation: the description states that one participant presents alternatives to another participant, whose selection determines which subsequent work is performed.

rules.instruction: When the description states a choice between alternatives that determines which branch is taken: Label the corresponding BPMN gateway to express that choice, and label its outgoing branches with the stated alternatives; do not substitute a different decision or an unsupported condition.
rules.situation: the description states a choice between alternatives that determines which branch is taken

rules.instruction: When the description says that updates are provided at regular time intervals while other work is still in progress: Model each update as a distinct action followed by an intermediate timer catch event, and repeat the update-and-wait cycle until the ongoing work is complete.
rules.situation: the description says that updates are provided at regular time intervals while other work is still in progress

rules.instruction: When the description states an activity or outcome and identifies its action, object, actor, or recipient: label the corresponding BPMN element with concise wording that preserves those stated details and does not substitute a different action or meaning
rules.situation: the description states multiple distinct activities or decisions that need separate BPMN elements
